title: Zero Sugar Korean Chocolate Jjigae
description: A low-fat, floral, and crumbly Korean dish featuring cocoa powder and bhuna, perfect for midnight cravings. This recipe is made in a cast-iron skillet and has a tangy flavor profile.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the gochujang and bhuna, and cook for 1 minute until the mixture is well combined.
Add the cocoa powder and cook for 1 minute until the mixture is fragrant.
Add the low-fat coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and add the diced tofu, cooking for 2 minutes until the tofu is coated in the sauce.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes until the sauce is thickened and the flavors are well combined.
Remove the skillet from the oven and garnish with chopped green onions.
Serve the Zero Sugar Korean Chocolate Jjigae hot in the cast-iron skillet.
